# compare

Compare schema between a data package and an environment, or between two environments. Differences are classified by severity (Error / Warning / Info); the highest severity determines the exit code. Supported output formats: Text (default), Json.

## Usage

```
ppds schema compare [options]
```

## Options

| Long | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--correlation-id` |  | `string` |  | Correlation ID for distributed tracing |
| `--data` |  | `FileInfo` |  | [Required with --environment] Path to a data package zip whose schema is compared against the target environment. |
| `--debug` |  | `bool` |  | Show trace-level diagnostic output |
| `--environment` | `-e` | `string` |  | [Required with --data] Target environment - URL, friendly name, unique name, or ID. |
| `--output-format` | `-f` | `OutputFormat` |  | Output format |
| `--profile` | `-p` | `string` |  | Authentication profile name (defaults to active profile). |
| `--quiet` | `-q` | `bool` |  | Show only warnings and errors |
| `--source-env` | `-se` | `string` |  | [Required with --target-env] Source environment for env-to-env comparison. |
| `--target-env` | `-te` | `string` |  | [Required with --source-env] Target environment for env-to-env comparison. |
| `--verbose` | `-v` | `bool` |  | Show detailed output including debug messages |
